title: Rav Huna son of Rav Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: His father is mentioned in Yoma 6b: “Rav Tachlifa, father of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa, said in Rava’s name.” Hyman says that he too always spoke in Rava’s name, as in Yevamot 8a, Bava Metzia 35a and Niddah 26a; in Kiddushin 71a Hyman calls “in Rav’s name” erroneous and proposes “in Rava’s name.”
In Zevachim 77a, Rav Rechumi said before Ravina in the name of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa.

notes.text: Hyman’s always-in-Rava’s-name assertion retains its strength, and the proposed Rav-to-Rava correction remains attributed. Rav, Rava and the father/son distinction are not harmonized.
